issues: Console warning 'In HTML, <a> cannot be a descendant of <a>' from AuthProvider tree and 'button cannot be a descendant of button' in ProtectedRoute – nested anchors/buttons somewhere in header/nav; non-blocking but should be cleaned to remove hydration warnings

action_items: IMPORTANT (fixed during test): The frontend webpack dev-server was serving a STALE bundle that did NOT include the FanReport component's testids (fan-report-*) even though FanReport.jsx and its import in PublicEngine.jsx were correct. The stale bundle caused the Fan Report section to be entirely absent from the public Match Center. Root cause: an earlier compile error ('Can\'t resolve @/components/fsl/GoogleButton' in Login.jsx) had produced a broken bundle that got cached; subsequent successful compiles did not force a full rebuild via hot reload. Testing agent performed `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` and the FanReport section then rendered correctly. Main agent should verify that the frontend is consistently rebuilding all imports (consider clearing .cache/ or forcing a full rebuild on next deploy).
critical_code_review_comments: fans.py:_apply (line 145-153): after 'profile_draft' is applied on approve, patch includes 'motto','description','colors','crest_url','cover_url','founded_year' at top-level Club only when data[k] not in (None,''). If admin approves with an empty string in draft, the field is silently dropped (kept at old value) – might mislead the society. Consider explicitly clearing when empty.
fans.py:review_profile (line 175-194): audit action uses body.get('action') which can be None or any string; validate action∈{'approve','reject'} explicitly and return 400 otherwise.

fans.py:fan_report (line 104-119): the throttling (>=3 open reports) uses status in ['open','reviewing'] but the FINAL constant is unused here; consider a small unit test to make sure closed/rejected reports don't count.
PublicEngine.jsx (line 110): FanReport is rendered inside PublicMatchCenter but there's no wrapping <section> for logged-out state's SectionTitle – minor a11y/visual polish; component itself works.
AuthContext.jsx (line 20): setUser(false) on 401 mixes types (null|false|user). Prefer setUser(null) and a separate `initialized` flag; consumers that do strict === null checks might break.
Register.jsx / Login.jsx: emit console hydration warnings ('<a> cannot be descendant of <a>') – nested Link components inside header brand link should be fixed.

rca of the issue: Only issue encountered: FanReport component absent from served bundle. Reproduction: fresh /tornei/{slug}/partite/{matchId} showed no fan-report* testids in DOM even logged out; curl of /static/js/bundle.js confirmed only 'fan-reports' (plural, from FanAccount) present; 'fan-report','fan-report-open' etc missing. Root cause: stale CRA webpack cache after a prior compile error for missing GoogleButton import; touching files didn't force full rebundle. Mitigation applied: `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`; after restart bundle contained all fan-report-* testids and section rendered correctly. Recommendation: consider dropping .cache before deploy or use `yarn start --reset-cache` in dev script.
